locations.title: BTMS partial-output admission
locations.observation: Source admits ISSUE unconditionally, accumulates per-asset totals, and admits individual acceptable outputs. Qualification must compare admitted indices to all requested outputs; do not infer transaction-level atomic token acceptance.

locations.title: BTMS admission regression witness
locations.observation: The repository includes a test deliberately exercising partial-prefix admission. It was read, not executed.

locations.title: Regulated monetary deltas
locations.observation: Exact holder transfer delta zero is an overlay predicate. Issue and redeem only constrain sign of delta here; CBDC officer quorum and treasury-owned retirement restriction remain application obligations.

locations.title: Concurrent supply cap
locations.observation: The cap reads current supply before admission. Prove deployment serialization/conflict handling for concurrent independent authority spends; this is a review obligation, not a reproduced exploit.

locations.title: Recovery authorization
locations.observation: Reissue references frozen state, positive replacement delta, no value inputs and named recipient. Review simultaneous or repeated reissues and stale control state.

locations.title: Overlay economic invalidation
locations.observation: The supply filter excludes evicted outputs. The code's own comment identifies reissued frozen coins as remaining on chain. Native unspentness and economic money status must be represented separately.

locations.title: Control exceptions
locations.observation: Frozen/evicted-input checks occur before authority-transaction bypass of pause/access. Do not paraphrase the implementation as either no exceptions or unrestricted issuer bypass.

locations.title: Rollback precondition
locations.observation: Input restoration requires caller confirmation that the engine regards it unspent and admitted again. Test actual reorg/eviction integration; merely finding the helper is not sufficient.

locations.title: Multiple-topic broadcast
locations.observation: An accepted second topic may enable broadcast when the CBDC topic rejects. Restrict/verify the requested topic set and test actual chain-spend reconciliation; no topical rejection can revoke Bitcoin-valid signatures.

locations.title: SPV bypass mode
locations.observation: Normal submissions call transaction verification; the internal historical-no-SPV mode depends on prior independent inclusion verification. Ensure untrusted callers cannot obtain its trust.

locations.title: Exact script family
locations.observation: Regulated Mandala intentionally narrows base BRC-162 to canonical P2PKH and one-satoshi carriers. A custom co-signature or covenant lock cannot be silently substituted while claiming this unchanged profile.

locations.title: Action schema vs treasury approval
locations.observation: Issue optionally carries bankRef; redeem has no action-specific required keys here. No independent officer approval was identified in inspected schema/checks. Additional signed evidence must bind exact instruction and transaction.

locations.title: Decoder consistency
locations.observation: BTMS client recognizes metadata beginning with a JSON-object prefix; topic manager uses a printable/signature heuristic. Differential-test malformed/alternate metadata, field counts and script shape before trusting equal decoding.

locations.title: Source/spec status mismatch
locations.observation: Pinned BRC-162 says no implementation while the pinned ts-stack source contains regulated Mandala. Record source/code profile independently; do not claim normative completeness from a shared name.

locations.title: Local lineage proof limits
locations.observation: BRC-176 scopes the proof to subject outputs and excludes global mint completeness and current UTXO membership. Regulated admin-control state is an additional obligation.

locations.title: Covenant origin authenticity
locations.observation: Concrete covenant specification separates script transition validity from authenticated genesis/lineage. Require counterfeit-copy tests for proposed currency covenants as well.
